user_saw: The Gateway froze for about two seconds while a plugin was being prepared on a host whose btrfs filesystem was waiting on a transaction commit.
summary: Moved creation and custody of plugin source/native capture roots and staging tokens from the Gateway main thread into the existing spawn-broker resource owner, so filesystem create stalls no longer block the event loop.
reasoning: The removed code did ordinary synchronous mkdtemp/metadata calls on the main thread as designed by the preparation-worker work (#172750, #184753); nothing regressed, and the stall came from the Team host's btrfs create waiting on a filesystem transaction (incident 2026-11-16), an environmental condition outside the code. The fix is an architectural off-main-thread move with accepted CPU/latency costs, so it is classified latent rather than a regression or never-worked; one could also argue not-a-defect (performance hardening), but there was a real reported stall.
